items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: come into Dr. Alsop's office and ask for me

ctx.x: gave her mother another box, and yesterday the mother called me and was talking to me. And I asked her what the girl wanted for Christmas, and what the girl's size was. And she told me size 18, because she's a big fat girl. And so I wasn't in a humor to talk, so I told her I was getting ready to go to work, but I'd call her.

So I called her this morning, and I told her that I had to go up to Hip Monday, and for her to see me at Hip (PHONETIC) Monday. She lives right around the corner from Hip, according to the address, and come into Dr. Alsop's office and ask for me, and that I would give her some money to buy her daughter some clothes. Which I'm going to do.
